item.name: institute
item.description:
Institute setup under `/institute`.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` only — no `X-Institute-Id` required for create.

**POST /** creates institute + first active `academicYear` + optional `affiliatedUniversity[]` in one transaction.

`universityId` is injected from token; do not send `universityId` / `instituteId` in body.

request.description:
**POST /institute** — create institute, initial active academic year, and affiliated universities in one transaction.

### Required body
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `campusId` | Must belong to authenticated university (`{{campus_id}}`) |
| `instituteName` | Display name |
| `instituteCode` | Unique code for institute |
| `academicYear.yearTitle` | e.g. `2025-2026` |
| `academicYear.startingDate` | Calendar start |
| `academicYear.endingDate` | Calendar end |

### Optional
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `affiliatedUniversity[]` | Array of `{ affiliatedUniversityName, affiliatedUniversityCode }` |

### Auto-filled (not in body)
- `universityId` — from bearer token
- `createdBy` — logged-in user
- `academicYear.isActive` — always `true` for new institute

### 201 response
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Institute created successfully",
  "data": {
    "instituteId": 12,
    "campusId": 11,
    "instituteName": "Engineering College",
    "instituteCode": "ENG-...",
    "affiliatedUniversity": [
      {
        "affiliatedUniversityId": 1,
        "affiliatedUniversityName": "State Technical University",
        "affiliatedUniversityCode": "STU-..."
      }
    ],
    "academicYear": {
      "acedmicYearId": 60,
      "universityId": 4,
      "instituteId": 12,
      "yearTitle": "2025-2026",
      "startingDate": "2025-07-01",
      "endingDate": "2026-06-30",
      "isActive": true
    }
  }
}
```

Test script sets `{{institute_id}}`, `{{acedmicYear_id}}`, `{{affiliated_university_id}}`.

item.name: academic year
item.description:
Academic year management under `/acedmicYear`.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`.

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| POST | `/acedmicYear` | Upsert + activate for active institute (`X-Institute-Id` or default) |
| GET | `/acedmicYear` | All years (active + inactive) for active institute |
| PATCH | `/acedmicYear` | Update active year (or optional `acedmicYearId` in body) |
| DELETE | `/acedmicYear?acedmicYearId=` | Soft-delete one year |
| GET | `/acedmicYear/active` | Active years for **auth context** institute |
| GET | `/acedmicYear/active/:instituteId` | Active years for **login-selected** institute (no `X-Institute-Id`) |
| POST | `/acedmicYear/newActivateAndCopyData` | Activate + optional copy subjects/electives/sessions |

**Tenant scope:** Writes and list/update/delete use `scoped(acedmicYearModel)` — `universityId` from token, `instituteId` from `X-Institute-Id` / `defaultInstituteId`. Do **not** send `universityId` / `instituteId` in body.

**Login flow:** After user picks institute at login, call **GET /active/:instituteId** with bearer token only to populate academic year dropdown before `X-Institute-Id` is set.

**Validation:** Zod on POST, PATCH, DELETE, and `/active/:instituteId`. **400** → `{ status: "error", message, errors[] }`.

header.description: Active institute — required unless user has defaultInstituteId

request.description:
**POST /acedmicYear**

Upsert + **activate** academic year for the **active university + institute**.

### Required body
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `yearTitle` | e.g. `2025-2026` |
| `startingDate` | Calendar start |
| `endingDate` | Calendar end |

### Auto-filled (not in body)
- `universityId`, `instituteId` — from auth context via `scoped().create()` / update
- `isActive` — always `true` after this call
- `updatedBy` — logged-in user

### Behavior
1. Deactivates other active years for this institute
2. If `yearTitle` exists for this institute → update dates and activate
3. Else if university-level orphan row (`instituteId` null) → claim for institute and activate
4. Else → create new row and activate

**201:** `{ message: "Academic year activated successfully", acedmicYear }`

Sets `{{acedmicYear_id}}` from response.

**GET /acedmicYear**

All academic years for the **active institute** (active + inactive), newest `createdAt` first.

Scoped via `universityId` + `instituteId` from auth — no query params.

**200:** array of academic year rows.

**GET /acedmicYear/active**

Only **activated** years (`isActive: true`) for the **active institute** from auth context (`X-Institute-Id` or `defaultInstituteId`).

**200:** array of active academic year rows (same shape as `/active/:instituteId`).

**GET /acedmicYear/active/:instituteId**

Active academic years (`isActive: true`) for the institute the user **selected at login**.

### When to use
- Login / institute-picker screen — user has token + chosen `instituteId` but may not have sent `X-Institute-Id` yet
- Same response array as **GET /active**, but institute comes from **URL param**, not auth header

### Params
| Param | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `instituteId` | yes | Path param — positive integer, e.g. `{{institute_id}}` |

### Auth
- Bearer `{{token}}` only (university from token)
- Institute must belong to user's university — **404** if not found
- **No** `X-Institute-Id` header required

### 200 response (array)
```json
[
  {
    "acedmicYearId": 60,
    "universityId": 4,
    "instituteId": 12,
    "yearTitle": "2025-2026",
    "startingDate": "2025-07-01",
    "endingDate": "2026-06-30",
    "isActive": true,
    "createdAt": "..."
  }
]
```

Test script sets `{{acedmicYear_id}}` from first row when present.

**PATCH /acedmicYear**

Update academic year for active institute (scoped).

**Default target:** active year from `X-Academic-Year-Id` (or token default). Omit `acedmicYearId` in body to update that year.

**Optional:** `acedmicYearId` — update a specific year instead.

**At least one of:** `yearTitle`, `startingDate`, `endingDate`

Tenant fields (`universityId`, `instituteId`, `isActive`) stripped from body.

**200** on success. **404** if not found in tenant scope. **400** if no active academic year in context.

**DELETE /acedmicYear?acedmicYearId=**

Soft-delete one academic year (scoped to active institute).

**200** on success. **404** if not found.

**POST /acedmicYear/newActivateAndCopyData**

Same upsert + activate as **POST /**, then optionally copy data from a previous year.

### Required body
`yearTitle`, `startingDate`, `endingDate`

### Optional
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `copyAcedmicYearId` | Source year PK (from **GET /** history) |
| `copyData` | Array: `subject`, `electiveSubject`, `session` |

Omit `copyAcedmicYearId` / `copyData` to activate only (same as POST /).

**201:** `{ message: "Academic year activated and data copied successfully", acedmicYear }`

item.name: syllabus
item.description:
Syllabus CRUD, course/semester subject lookups, and **syllabus units** (topic slabs per subject).

**Base path:** `/syllabus`

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`. Tenant scope from token/headers (`X-Academic-Year-Id` for year-scoped reads).

**Suggested flow:**
1. **GET courseSubject** — subjects for course + session
2. **POST /** — create syllabus with subject term marks
3. **POST addUnit** — add unit slabs for a subject
4. **GET getUnit?subjectId=** — list units for a subject
5. **PATCH unit** / **DELETE unit?syllabusUnitId=** — maintain units (DELETE uses scoped tenant only; no `acedmicYearId` in query)

request.description: **GET /syllabus?acedmicYearId=** — list syllabi for academic year.
**GET /syllabus/single?SyllabusId=** — single syllabus with details.

**POST /syllabus**

**Required:** `courseId`, `acedmicYearId`, `instituteId`, `sessionId`, `subjects[]` with `subjectId`, `subjectType`, `total`, `term[]` (`examSetupTypeId`, `type`, `marks`).
**PATCH /syllabus** — `SyllabusId` required in body.
**DELETE /syllabus?SyllabusId=**
**GET /syllabus/courseSubject** — subjects for course + session (syllabus setup helper).
**GET /syllabus/semesterSubject?semesterId=** — subjects linked to syllabus for a semester.

**POST /syllabus/addUnit**

**Required:** `subjectId`, `acedmicYearId`, `sessionId`, `slab[]` (`unitNumber`, `name`).

**Optional:** `semesterId` (nullable for session-level units).

**Optional slab fields:** `description`, `contactHours`.

query.description: Required — returns all units for this subject

request.description:
**GET /syllabus/getUnit?subjectId=**

List syllabus units for a subject (tenant-scoped). Ordered by `unitNumber`.

**PATCH /syllabus/unit**

**Required:** `syllabusUnitId`, `acedmicYearId`, plus at least one of `unitNumber`, `name`, `description`, `contactHours`.

**DELETE /syllabus/unit?syllabusUnitId=**

Deletes one syllabus unit by PK. Tenant scope from `scoped(syllabusUnitModel)` (university / institute / academic year).

item.name: time table
item.description:
Timetable APIs under `/timeTable` (structure/periods) and `/timeTableCreate` (routine + grid cells).

| Phase | Base | Purpose |
|-------|------|--------|
| Structure | `/timeTable` | Bell schedule template + period rows |
| Routine | `/timeTableCreate` | Link structure to section + date range |
| Mapping | `/timeTableCreate/mapping` | Fill day/period cells (`class_schedule_item`) |
| Publish | `/timeTableCreate/publish` | Lock routine for students/teachers |

**Tenant scope:** GET structure/routine lists use `scoped()` — institute + academic year from auth context. Query `acedmicYearId` is optional (accepted for frontend compat, **not used** by API).

**Validation:** All `/timeTable` and `/timeTableCreate` routes use Zod. Invalid input → **400** `{ status: "error", message, errors[] }`.

**Suggested flow:** structure → create routine → mapping cells → subjectCount → publish → getRoutine.

Folder vars `timetable_*` on Variables tab. Auth: Bearer `{{token}}`.

Campus PK — required on routine create

**POST /timeTable**

Creates a timetable **structure** (period slots).

**Body (Zod — all optional at route; controller may still validate):** `name`, `maximumPeriod`, `periodLength`, `periodGap`, `startingTime`, `type` (`Automatic`|`Manual`), optional `courseId`, `sessionId`, `acedmicYearId`, `weekOff`, `isCourse`.

When `courseId` is sent, controller expects `sessionId` or `acedmicYearId` in body. Tenant scope on create via `scoped(timeTableStructureModel)`.

**200** — array of created period rows. **400** — Zod or business validation JSON/text.

query.description: Optional — ignored; tenant scope from auth context

**GET /timeTable**

Lists timetable structures with periods, course, session (`timeTableSession`), and `weekOff`.

**Query:** optional `courseId`. Scoped via `scoped(timeTableStructureModel)` (institute + academic year from token).

**Optional ignored:** `acedmicYearId` (frontend compat).

query.description: Optional — ignored; tenant scope from auth context

**GET /timeTable/all_name**

Same shape as **GET /timeTable**. Optional `courseId`, `sessionId`. Tenant scope from `scoped(timeTableStructureModel)`.

query.description: Optional — ignored; tenant scope from auth context

request.description:
**GET /timeTable/single**

Optional `courseId`, `sessionId`. Scoped via `scoped(timeTableStructureModel)`. Includes session info and `weekOff`.

**PATCH /timeTable**

Non-empty array of period updates. Each item **requires** `timeTableCreationId`. Optional: `startTime`, `endTime`, `periodName`, `isCourse`, `isBreak`, `type`.

**400** — Zod validation JSON on invalid body.

**DELETE /timeTable?timeTableCreationId=**

Soft-deletes one period row. **Required query:** `timeTableCreationId`.

**POST /timeTableCreate**

Creates a **routine** — links a structure to a class section for a date range.

**Body (Zod — fields optional at route):** `timeTableNameId`, `courseId`, `classSectionsId`, `campusId`, `startingDate`, `endingDate`, `timeTableType`, optional `acedmicYearId` (ignored on create — `scoped` injects tenant).

**Optional split flow:** `previousDate` + `timeTableRoutineId`.

Validates no overlapping date range for the section. Saves `timeTableRoutineId` to `timetable_routineId`.

**POST /timeTableCreate/clone**

Copies a routine and all its mapping cells to a new date range.

**Required body:** `previousRoutineId`, `startingDate`, `endingDate` (`endingDate` >= `startingDate`).

**GET /timeTableCreate**

Lists all routines with structure, course, campus, class section, and academic year.

**GET /timeTableCreate/single?courseId=**

Routines filtered by course.

item.name: employee
item.description:
Employee APIs under `/employee`.

**Teacher helpers:** `courses` (mapping-based courses), `coursesFromSchedule` (timetable-based courses/subjects) — both scoped by auth academic year; no `acedmicYearId` query.

query.description: true = merge consecutive periods (same date, routine, subject). false = one row per period.
Optional — cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Only dates strictly before this are returned.

request.description:
**GET /employee/pastSchedule**

Past timetable slots for a teacher (published routines, scoped by auth academic year).

### Query
| Param | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `employeeId` | yes | Teacher employeeId |
| `groupPeriods` | no | `true` / `false` (default `false`) |
| `date` | no | Cutoff date; slots before this date only |

### Attendance status (per period)
Each schedule row includes **`attendanceStatus`**:
- `MARKED` — at least one attendance row exists for `timeTableMappingId` + `date`
- `PENDING` — not marked yet

### Grouped mode (`groupPeriods=true`)
Consecutive periods merge into one object with `classScheduleItems[]` and group-level **`attendanceStatus`**:
- `MARKED` — all periods in the group are marked
- `PARTIAL` — some marked, some pending
- `PENDING` — none marked

**Note:** `POST /attendance` accepts `timeTableMappingId` as a number or array — one POST can mark all periods in a group.

### 200 response shape
```json
{
  "teacher": { "employeeId", "employeeName", "employeeCode", "pickColor" },
  "schedules": [ ... ]
}
```

**GET /employee/courses?employeeId=**

Distinct courses for a teacher from `teacher_subject_mapping` → `subject` → `courseInfo`.

**Scoped:** `scoped(teacherSubjectMapping)` + `buildScope(subjectModel)` (academic year from auth). No `acedmicYearId` query param.

**200:** `{ success: true, result: [{ courseId, courseName, courseCode }] }`.

**GET /employee/coursesFromSchedule?employeeId=**

Courses + subjects assigned via timetable cells (`class_schedule_item`) for the teacher.

**Scoped:** `timeTableRoutineModel` + `subjectModel` academic year from auth context.

**200:** `{ success: true, result: { courses: [...], subjects: [...] } }`.

item.name: Students
item.description:
Student read APIs and **promotion** flow.

### Promotion run order
1. **GET /student?studentId=** — note `courseId`, `sessionId`, `semesterId`, `classSectionsId`, current `term`
2. **GET /student/promotion/available-section** — `courseId`, `term`, `classSectionId` → target sections for next term/year

request.description:
**POST /attendance**

Mark attendance for one or more class periods on one date.

### Required body
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `classSectionsId` | Class section PK |
| `timeTableMappingId` | **number** (one period) **or number[]** (grouped periods) |
| `date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `attendance` | Array of per-student rows |

### Optional
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `section` | Ignored by API (display only) |

### Each `attendance[]` item
| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `studentId` | yes | |
| `attendanceStatus` | yes | Present, Absent, Medical Leave, Duty Leave, Sports Leave, NCC Leave, Approved Leave, Holiday |
| `notes` | no | |
| `description` | no | |

### Behavior
- Duplicate check per `timeTableMappingId` + `date` — already-marked periods are **skipped**; only remaining periods are inserted. Fails only if **all** periods are already marked (or single period already marked)
- Injects `createdBy` / `updatedBy` from token; tenant columns from scoped create

`{ "message": "Attendance Add Successfully" }` — when some periods were skipped, also returns `markedPeriods` and `skippedPeriods` arrays

item.description:
Library issue/return flow under `/libraryIssueBook`.

**Test order:** create ΓåÆ get all/get single ΓåÆ **get inventory issue history** (by `inventoryId`) ΓåÆ update with `returnItems` (partial/full return) ΓåÆ update due date/inventory if needed.

**Rules**
- `memberType`: `STUDENT` | `TEACHER`; `memberId` maps to student/employee PK
- Transaction: `issueDate`, `dueDate` (`dueDate` >= `issueDate`)
- Return is stored in `library_return_book_transaction`; inventory item links via `libraryReturnBookTransactionId`
- Active issue = item row with `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` NULL; same `inventoryId` can be re-issued after return
- For same `returnDate`, one return transaction can be reused for multiple returned items
- `library_book_inventory.status`: `available` ΓåÆ `issued` on issue, back to `available` on return
- `inventoryItems[]` on update replaces outstanding copies (auto-returns old active items)
- `returnItems[]` on update returns selected books by item id or inventory id
- **GET /inventoryIssueHistory?inventoryId=** ΓÇö accession copy + all issue rows for that inventory (nested `bookDetails`, `issueBookTransaction` with `studentMember` / `teacherMember`)

Auth: Bearer {{token}}

request.description:
**POST /libraryIssueBook**

Creates transaction + items (initially `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` is `null`). Sets each `library_book_inventory.status` to `issued`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `memberId`, `memberType` | Yes | STUDENT ΓåÆ student_id, TEACHER ΓåÆ employee_id |
| `issueDate`, `dueDate` | Yes | `dueDate` >= `issueDate` |
| `inventoryItems[]` | No | Copy must be `available`; unique per request |

**GET /libraryIssueBook**

List issue transactions with pagination and common search.

### Params type (frontend)

```ts
type GetAllIssueTransactionsQuery = {
  page?: number; // default 1
  limit?: number; // default 20
  search?: string; // optional common search
};
```

### Notes
- Send params in query string (no request body)
- `search` works across member/date/book related fields

**GET /libraryIssueBook/inventoryIssueHistory**

Query: `inventoryId` (required) ΓÇö `library_book_inventory.inventory_id` (accession copy).

Returns:
- `book` ΓÇö inventory row with nested `bookDetails` (`title`, `authors`, `isbn`, `accessionNumber`, `status`, ΓÇª)
- `issueCount` ΓÇö total issue entries for this copy
- `issueHistory[]` ΓÇö each `library_book_issue_inventory_item` with nested `issueBookTransaction` (`issueDate`, `dueDate`, `memberType`, `studentMember` or `teacherMember`) and optional `returnBookTransaction` (`libraryReturnBookTransactionId`, `returnDate`)

404 when `inventoryId` not found.

**GET /libraryIssueBook/returnTransactions**

Lists return batches grouped by `library_return_book_transaction` (one row per **returnDate**). Multiple books returned on the same date appear under the same record.

### Query params

```ts
type GetReturnTransactionsQuery = {
  page?: number; // default 1
  limit?: number; // default 20
  search?: string; // returnDate, member, accession, title, isbn, ΓÇª
};
```

`{{baseurl}}/libraryIssueBook/returnTransactions?page={{page}}&limit={{limit}}&search={{search}}`

### Response shape (per row)

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` | PK of return batch |
| `returnDate` | Shared date for all books in this batch |
| `totalReturnedBooks` | Count of copies in this batch |
| `totalIssueTransactions` | Distinct issue transactions involved |
| `issueTransactions[]` | Grouped by original issue |

Each `issueTransactions[]` entry:
- `libraryIssueBookTransactionId`, `memberId`, `memberType`, `issueDate`, `dueDate`, `member`
- `returnedBooks[]` ΓÇö `{ libraryBookIssueInventoryItemId, inventoryId, book }` (`book` includes `bookDetails`)

### Example (two books, same returnDate)

```json
{
  "libraryReturnBookTransactionId": 3,
  "returnDate": "2026-06-02",
  "totalReturnedBooks": 2,
  "totalIssueTransactions": 1,
  "issueTransactions": [
    {
```

- **dueAmount** = total ΓêÆ paidAmount; reject if amount > dueAmount

- `lastPayment` ΓÇö latest INCOMING payment (`studentFeePaymentId`, `amount`, `paymentMethod`, `paymentDate`) or `null`
- `outstandingAmount` ΓÇö sum of `balanceDue` on unpaid/partial invoices
- `totalPaymentReceived` ΓÇö sum of **payment_item** amounts (INCOMING) across all student invoices

**Per invoice (in `invoices[]`, unpaid/partial only):**
- `total` from **student_fee_invoice_items** (sum amount ΓêÆ waiver)
- `paidAmount` from **payment_item** SUM
- `balanceDue` = total ΓêÆ paidAmount

**data:** `{ student, totalInvoices, lastPayment, outstandingAmount, totalPaymentReceived, invoices[] }`

```json
  "payeeId": 2152,
  "payeeType": "STUDENT",
  "amount": "8000.00",
  "paymentItems": [
```

- **amount** must equal sum of `paymentItems[].amount`.

**Optional:** paymentType (default INCOMING), referenceNumber, transactionId (auto UUID if omitted), receivedBy, remark.

**data:** `{ payment, verified: { payeeId, total, paymentItems[] } }` ΓÇö verified items include referenceId, referenceType, and invoice totals when referenceType is STUDENT_FEE_INVOICE. Sets `studentFeePayment_id`.

## assetCategory

**POST body:** `{ "name": "..." }` only ΓÇö do **not** send `codePrefix` (server sets it from name).

| Name (seeded / example) | `codePrefix` |
|-------------------------|-------------|
| IT Assets | IT |

| Custom e.g. Electronics | ELEC (derived) |

**PATCH:** `assetCategoryId` + optional `name`. Prefix is not changed on update.

Run **get all** after migration to pick an existing seeded category instead of **create**.

request.description:
**POST /assetCategory** ΓÇö create category.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `name` | yes | Do **not** send `codePrefix` |

Response: `assetCategoryId`, `name`, `codePrefix` (e.g. IT Assets ΓåÆ `IT`). Sets `{{assetCategory_id}}`.

Prefer **get all** and use an existing seeded **IT Assets** row when migration has already run.

**Other examples (valid JSON only in Body):** `{ "name": "Electronics" }` ΓåÆ prefix `ELEC`. Seeded: Land & Buildings (`LDB`), Furniture & Fixtures (`FURN`).
**GET /assetCategory** ΓÇö list categories for institute. Each row includes `codePrefix` (used for auto asset codes).
**GET /assetCategory/single?assetCategoryId=** ΓÇö `assetCategoryId`, `name`, `codePrefix`.

**PATCH /assetCategory** ΓÇö `assetCategoryId` required; at least `name`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `assetCategoryId` | yes | |
| `name` | yes (on PATCH) | `codePrefix` is read-only ΓÇö not accepted in body |
Fails if any **asset** rows still reference this category.

**POST /asset** ΓÇö Create asset + inventory. **Do not send `code`** ΓÇö response includes auto `code` (e.g. name **Table** in **Furniture & Fixtures** ΓåÆ `FURN-TBL001`) and `inventoryItems[].code` (e.g. `FURN-TBL001-0001`).

**`inventoryBulk[]`** (optional on create; omit key for master-only):

| Row field | Required | Notes |
|-----------|----------|--------|
| `count` | yes | Min 1 per row |
| `classRoomSectionId` | no | Omit or `null` ΓåÆ `NOT_ASSIGNED`; set ΓåÆ `ASSIGNED` |

Example: 2 in room + 2 unassigned = 4 copies. Unassigned-only: `"inventoryBulk": [{ "count": 4 }]`.

Required master: `name`, `condition`, `assetCategoryId`. Body must be strict JSON (no `//` comments).

**GET /asset/codepreview** ΓÇö read-only preview of the next auto-generated asset `code` for `name` + `assetCategoryId`.

Does **not** save or reserve the code. **POST /asset** with the same `name` and `assetCategoryId` assigns the next available code at save time (usually matches preview unless another asset was created in between).

**Response:** `name`, `assetCategoryId`, `assetCategoryName`, `code` (e.g. `IT-DLL001`).

query.description: Optional. Partial match on asset name, code, or category name

request.description:
**GET /asset** ΓÇö paginated list.

| Query | Default |
|-------|--------|
| `page` | 1 |
| `limit` | 20 (max 100) |
| `status` | `all` ΓÇö filters nested `inventoryItems` only (`assigned` \| `unassigned`) |
| `search` | optional ΓÇö partial match on asset `name`, `code`, or category `name` only |

**GET /asset/single?assetId=** ΓÇö asset master + `totalInventory`, `issuedCount`, `nonIssuedCount`, `inventoryItems[]` (code, barcode, status, `classRoomSectionId`, `classRoom`).

**PATCH /asset** ΓÇö Same **`inventoryBulk[]`** as POST create. `assetId` required; at least one other field. Body must be strict JSON (no `//` comments).

| Optional | Purpose |

item.name: assetIssue
item.description:
## Asset issue / return (all APIs)

**Prerequisite:** **asset ΓåÆ create** first. Use `{{assetInventoryItem_id}}` on issue (must be `NOT_ASSIGNED` or returned).

| # | Method | Path | Notes |
|---|--------|------|--------|
| 1 | POST | `/assetIssue` | Issue; optional `securityAmount` |
| 2 | GET | `/assetIssue` | List ΓÇö no payments |
| 3 | GET | `/assetIssue/single` | One issue ΓÇö includes `securityPayment` if any |
| 4 | GET | `/assetIssue/payments` | Payments for `assetIssueTransactionId` |
| 5 | PATCH | `/assetIssue` | Update member/dates |
| 6 | POST | `/assetIssue/return` | Return lines; optional deposit settlement |
| 7 | GET | `/assetIssue/return` | List returns ΓÇö no payments |
| 8 | GET | `/assetIssue/return/payments` | Return settlement (`assetReturnTransactionId`) |

**Return:** `returnCondition` required per item. `securityAmount` + `fineAmount` must be sent together for settlement. `paymentMethod`: `cash` \| `credit_card` \| `bank_transfer` \| `cheque`.

request.description:
**POST /assetIssue**

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `memberId`, `memberType` | yes | `STUDENT` or `TEACHER` |
| `issueDate`, `dueDate` | yes | `dueDate` >= `issueDate` |
| `items[]` | yes | `{ assetInventoryItemId }` ΓÇö copy must not already be on open issue |
| `securityAmount` | no | Creates `ASSET_SECURITY` payment when set |
| `paymentMethod` | no | Default `cash`; also `credit_card`, `bank_transfer`, `cheque` |

Response: issue row + `items[]` + optional `securityPayment`. Sets `assetIssueTransaction_id`, `assetIssueInventoryItem_id`.
**GET /assetIssue** ΓÇö paginated issues. Each row: `memberBasicDetails`, `issuedTotalItems` (lines on this issue), `returnedTotalItems` (returned lines), `items[]` (no payments).

**GET /assetIssue/payments?assetIssueTransactionId=** ΓÇö payments for one issue.

Response: `memberBasicDetails` (issue member) + `payments[]` each with `payeeDetails` (name, scholarNumber/course for student; employeeName/code for teacher).

`paymentPurpose`: `ASSET_SECURITY` | `RETURN_SETTLEMENT`.

**GET /assetIssue/single?assetIssueTransactionId=** ΓÇö same as list row: `issuedTotalItems`, `returnedTotalItems`, `items[]`, optional `securityPayment`. Use **get issue payments by id** for `payments[]` only.
**PATCH /assetIssue** ΓÇö `assetIssueTransactionId` + optional `memberId`, `memberType`, `issueDate`, `dueDate`. Returns same shape as GET single.

**POST /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö with deposit settlement.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `returnDate` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DD`; >= each line `issueDate` |
| `items[]` | yes | `assetIssueInventoryItemId`, `returnCondition`, optional `damageNotes` |
| `securityAmount`, `fineAmount` | together | Both required to record settlement payment; omit both for return-only (see **return (no settlement)**) |
| `paymentMethod` | no | Default `cash` |

Sets `assetReturnTransaction_id`. Use **get return payments by id** for settlement details.
**POST /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö return only (no `securityAmount` / `fineAmount`). No deposit settlement payment.
**GET /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö `data.assetReturnTransactions[]` (`returnDate`, `items[]`), `pagination`. No payment rows (use **get return payments by id**).

**GET /assetIssue/return/payments?assetReturnTransactionId=** ΓÇö settlement payment(s) for this return only.

Response: `memberBasicDetails` (member from returned lines) + `payments[]` each with `payeeDetails`. Empty `payments[]` if no settlement recorded.

| Field | Required | Notes |

| `instituteId` | yes | |
| `campusId` | no | Must belong to same university if provided |

item.name: governance
item.description:
Governance **Bodies** under `/governanceBody`.

| POST | `/governanceBody` | Create body |
| GET | `/governanceBody` | List all (includes `parentBody`) |
| GET | `/governanceBody/single` | Get one — `?governanceBodyId=` |

**category:** Authority, Board, Committee, Council, Cell, Task Force, Working Group

request.description:
**POST /governanceBody** — create a governance body.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `name` | yes | |
| `code` | yes | Unique per institute |
| `category` | yes | Authority, Board, Committee, Council, Cell, Task Force, Working Group |
| `description` | no | |
| `parentBodyId` | no | Optional parent body in same institute |
| `constitutedOn` | no | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `effectiveFrom` / `effectiveTo` | no | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `status` | no | Active (default), Inactive, Dissolved |

Sets `{{governance_body_id}}` from response.
**GET /governanceBody** — list all governance bodies for the institute. Each item may include nested `parentBody`.
**GET /governanceBody/single?governanceBodyId=** — fetch one governance body with optional `parentBody` include.

**PATCH /governanceBody** — update a governance body.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `governanceBodyId` | yes | |

Updatable: `name`, `code`, `category`, `description`, `parentBodyId` (null to clear), `constitutedOn`, `effectiveFrom`, `effectiveTo`, `status`

**DELETE /governanceBody?governanceBodyId=** — permanently delete a governance body.

item.name: course
item.description:
Course & subject setup under `/main/course`, `/main/subject`, and read APIs under `/course`, `/subject`.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`. Institute + academic year from login (`utility/scoped.js`). Optional `X-Institute-Id` header.

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| POST | `/main/course` | Create one or more courses |
| PATCH | `/main/course` | Update `courseName`, `courseCode`, `departmentId` |
| PATCH | `/main/course/status` | Set `isActive` true/false |
| POST | `/main/subject` | Create subject (scoped tenant on `subjectModel`) |
| PATCH | `/main/subject/update` | Update subject fields |
| DELETE | `/course/:courseId` | Delete if not session-mapped |
| GET | `/course`, `/subject` | List / read helpers |

**Subject create:** `subjectType` + `subjectCategory` required (Zod). Tenant IDs not accepted in body.

**Inactive course:** cannot add subjects or new session mappings.

request.description:
**POST /main/course** — create one or more courses.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `course_levelId` | yes | Course level master type id |
| `courses[]` | yes | At least one course |
| `courses[].courseName` | yes | |
| `courses[].courseCode` | yes | |
| `departmentId` | no | Root default for all courses in batch |
| `courses[].departmentId` | no | Overrides root; can be set later via PATCH |
| `affiliatedUniversityId` | no | Defaults to institute's affiliated university |
| `term` | no | `semester` (default), `trimester`, `quarterly`, `yearly` |
| `courses[].courseDuration` | no | Years — used to compute `totalTerms` |
| `courses[].capacity` | no | |

Sets `{{course_id}}` from first created course.

**POST /main/subject** — create a subject for a course.

**Tenant scope:** `universityId`, `instituteId`, `acedmicYearId` injected via `scoped(subjectModel)` from login — do not send in body.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `courseId` | yes | Program/course PK |
| `subjectCode` | yes | Unique code |
| `subjectName` | yes | |
| `subjectType` | yes | One of: Core, Elective, Open Elective, Department Elective, Foundation, Skill Enhancement, Ability Enhancement, Value Added, Internship, Dissertation, Audit |
| `subjectCategory` | yes | One of: Theory, Practical, Lab, Project, Seminar, Workshop |
| `shortName` | no | |
| `description` | no | |
| `isActive` | no | Default `true` |
| `specializationId` | no | |
| `term` | no | Term/semester number |

Course must be **active**. Sets `{{subject_id}}` on success.

**PATCH /main/subject/update** — update subject fields.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `subjectId` | yes | |
| `courseId` | no | If changed, target course must be active |
| `subjectCode` | no | |
| `subjectName` | no | |
| `shortName` | no | Send `null` to clear |
| `description` | no | Send `null` to clear |
| `subjectType` | no | Core, Elective, Open Elective, Department Elective, Foundation, Skill Enhancement, Ability Enhancement, Value Added, Internship, Dissertation, Audit |
| `subjectCategory` | no | Theory, Practical, Lab, Project, Seminar, Workshop |
| `isActive` | no | |
| `specializationId` | no | Send `null` to clear |
| `term` | no | Send `null` to clear |

At least one field besides `subjectId` is required. Scoped update — tenant IDs from login only.

**PATCH /main/course** — update course details.

Only these fields can be changed: `courseName`, `courseCode`, `departmentId`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `courseId` | yes | |
| `courseName` | no | At least one updatable field required |
| `courseCode` | no | |
| `departmentId` | no | Send `null` to clear department link |

**PATCH /main/course/status** — activate a course.

Same endpoint for activate and deactivate; set `isActive` to `true` or `false`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `courseId` | yes | |
| `isActive` | yes | `true` = active, `false` = inactive |

**When inactive:** new subjects and new session mappings are blocked.

**PATCH /main/course/status** — deactivate a course.

Same endpoint as activate; set `"isActive": false`.

Inactive courses cannot receive new subjects or be mapped to new sessions.

**DELETE /course/:courseId** — permanently delete a course.

**Allowed only when:** course `courseId` has **no row** in `session_course_mapping` (checked across the full table).

**Also removes** setup data created after course creation:
- Specializations
- Subjects (+ class-subject mappers, teacher mappings)
- Semesters
- Grade courses, POs, exam setup terms, syllabus, timetable structures, etc.

**400** if session-mapped.
**404** if course not found.
